record.question: The type of fluid which causes water to shift from cells into blood stream?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Hypertonic. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q5. The exam chooses hypertonic fluid, describing the osmotic movement of water out of cells. Albumin principally changes oncotic pressure across the vascular compartment rather than being the same crystalloid-tonicity category.
